claims.assertion: Mari calls Sadicleya a Toleka-class Mark II deep-space yacht, larger than Mark I, with eight main and four maneuvering engines producing more power and stronger shields.
claims.speaker: Mari Swa
claims.qualifiers: She says its precise dimensions remain uncertain.

claims.assertion: Mari says Sadicleya has village-like decks, parks, simulated horizons, weather, seasons, and beach facilities to support crew wellbeing on long missions.
claims.speaker: Mari Swa

claims.assertion: Mari says Sadicleya is her new flagship in low Earth orbit, escorted by four ships and intended for fewer than one hundred crew.
claims.speaker: Mari Swa
claims.qualifiers: Original Toleka crew remain aboard for now.

coverage_gaps: Sadicleya namesake star and relocation details omitted
